abstract: Evaluates civil engineering readiness, draft depth specifications, and automated quay crane infrastructure
system_message:
You are the Port Infrastructure Director (PID), responsible for evaluating civil engineering readiness, draft depth specifications, automated quay crane infrastructure, and berth structural maintenance for terminal operating consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates civil engineering readiness, draft depth specifications, and automated quay crane infrastructure（CIVENG）
information_points.content:
PID-CIVENG-9E2：For Euro-Baltic Intermodal Gateway under the Production environment, technical reviews indicate the electrified dockside crane system is not present (false), hydrographic records verify a berth draft depth of 19 m at the main berthing pocket, and operational simulations demonstrate a quay crane net handling rate of 34 moves/h.
PID-CIVENG-MSJ：For North Sea Automated Terminals under the Test environment, concession reviews indicate an electrified dockside crane system is not provided (false), bathymetric records reflect a berth draft depth of 17 m, and simulation benchmarks record a quay crane net handling rate of 30 moves/h.
PID-CIVENG-709：For Maas River Logistics Alliance under the Production environment, concession audits confirm an electrified dockside crane system (true), hydrographic surveys record a berth draft depth of 18 m at the main container vessel berthing pocket, and simulation benchmarks show a quay crane net handling rate of 38 moves/h.
PID-CIVENG-9JA：For North Sea Automated Terminals under the Production environment, technical concession reviews confirm an electrified dockside crane system (true), hydrographic surveys certify a berth draft depth of 20 m at the main berthing pocket, and operational simulations establish a quay crane net handling rate of 38 moves/h.

information_points.title: Berth structural maintenance（DOCKREP）
information_points.content:
PID-DOCKREP-3KX：According to the civil asset register, Maas River Logistics Alliance has a scheduled dry-dock maintenance interval of 48 months for the primary deepwater quay wall structure.
PID-DOCKREP-C1R：According to the civil asset register, North Sea Automated Terminals maintains a scheduled dry-dock maintenance interval of 36 months for the primary deepwater quay wall structure.
PID-DOCKREP-7NR：According to the civil asset register, Euro-Baltic Intermodal Gateway has a scheduled dry-dock maintenance interval of 24 months for the primary deepwater quay wall structure.
